text_block_list.text:
So, it's settled! We'll be havin' our singin'
lessons...
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa! The blue sky, the white clouds,
this indescribable scent of
the wild! Why?!
Oh, WHY?! Answer me, Shiraoki!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Oh! Scarlet, get a load of that bull over there! It's huge! Man, I wanna grab those handlebar horns and drive it around like a motorcycle!
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text:
This isn't the time to be messing around!
We're supposed to be
having a rehearsal!
Ugh, I knew something smelled fishy once
we got
on that train...
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
No, no, there's a good reason I brought
y'all this far! I heard the
venue for the
commemorative concert is gonna be
enormous!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
That's why we're here at this big ol' ranch
where we can practice
singin' big and loud!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл
